title: MITC6-a Bryan plate under uniaxial compression (8x8 split mesh)
source: G.H. Bryan, Proc. London Math. Soc.22:54–67(1891); Timoshenko & Gere1961 §9.2: Ncr=4pi²D/a²; same public reference as buckle-plate-square. Independent published coefficient K=4.00: Nemeth, Stein & Johnson, NASA TP-2528 (1986), p.10 Table I, isotropic d/W=0 (unperforated square); https://ntrs.nasa.gov/citations/19860011385. Uniform displacement and uniform traction give the same constant membrane preload in this unperforated case.; Element: Lee & Bathe (2004), doi:10.1016/j.compstruc.2004.02.004, MITC6-a equations (29)-(38).

quantities.reason: Fixed2% thin-plate/FSDT and split8x8 (128 triangles) MITC6-a mesh band, h/a=.01; unit edge membrane load.
